meaningStory: A person points at every possibility and asks: what is it?

readings.story: Nani points at the unknown thing and asks what it is: Nani gives なに.
Nan is the person who always asks what: Nan gives you なん.

meaningStory: A curved enclosure around a center line looks like a round coin: a circle worth yen.

readings.story: The ENclosed round coin starts with えん.

meaningStory: One unbroken line is the simplest possible picture of one.

readings.story: Each single line is one: “each” points to いち.
One person is ひとり, so one thing begins with ひと.

meaningStory: Add a second line and the count becomes two.

readings.story: You have two knees; knee sounds like に.
Two things need two lids: ふた means lid and recalls ふたつ.

meaningStory: Three parallel lines give you the number three at a glance.

readings.story: The sun rises over three lines; sun sounds like さん.
In 三つ（みっつ）, み tightens to みっ before つ: picture three lines packed tightly together.

meaningStory: Four little legs are tucked inside an enclosure: count every corner to get four.

readings.story: She counts four corners: she sounds like し.
In 四つ（よっつ）, よ tightens to よっ before つ: four corners snap into place.

meaningStory: Crossing strokes between two bars make a five-mark tally.

readings.story: Go count the five marks: go sounds like ご.
Eat two of five treats: “eat two” recalls いつ.

meaningStory: Lift the lid and six pieces split outward underneath it.

readings.story: A lock has six pins; lock sounds like ろく.
In 六つ（むっつ）, む tightens to むっ before つ: six pieces lock together.

meaningStory: A line cut by a sharp hook leaves a shape for seven.

readings.story: She cheers for lucky seven: she cheers starts like しち.
Nana always chooses number seven: Nana gives なな.

meaningStory: Two strokes spread apart like a pie divided into eight slices.

readings.story: Eight chicks hatch; hatch points to はち.
In 八つ（やっつ）, や tightens to やっ before つ: eight strokes spread, then stop sharply.

meaningStory: A slash and a bent hook curl into the last single digit: nine.

readings.story: Nine people wait in a queue; queue sounds like きゅう.
Coco owns nine coconuts: Coco points to ここの.

meaningStory: A vertical tally crosses a horizontal row after the tenth mark.

readings.story: Ten boxes of juice: juice starts like じゅう.
Ten toes make とお easy to recall.

meaningStory: One white sheet is covered with a hundred tiny tally marks.

readings.story: A hundred yaks shout “hyaku!”: yak helps you hear ひゃく.

meaningStory: A slanted multiplier over ten sends the count soaring to one thousand.

readings.story: Send one thousand coins: send begins like せん.

meaningStory: Give one number enormous power and it grows to ten thousand.

readings.story: One man counts ten thousand coins: man sounds like まん.

meaningStory: A treasured jewel protected inside a border represents a country.

readings.story: Kuni guards the jewel and the whole country: Kuni gives くに.
Every country ships its own Coke: Coke points to こく.

meaningStory: At evening roll call, each mouth speaks its name.

readings.story: Nana says the first part of her name: な.
May announces her name in May: May sounds like めい.

meaningStory: Clear the grass with a blade before the body can move to the front.

readings.story: Mae always walks in front; Mae sounds like まえ.
A zen leader sits at the front: zen sounds like ぜん.

meaningStory: A child under a school roof catches falling sparks of knowledge and learns to study.

readings.story: Gaku studies under the roof; his name gives you がく.

meaningStory: A fresh sprout pushes through the soil: a picture of birth and life.

readings.story: Say that the student is full of life: say sounds like せい.
A new life is born with うま, as in 生まれる（うまれる）.

meaningStory: A person stretches both arms as wide as possible to show something large.

readings.story: “Oh! Oh!” you shout at something very large: おお.
A giant die looks large; die sounds like だい.

meaningStory: Two hands reach toward one another in friendship.

readings.story: Tom offers his hand to a friend: Tom points to とも.

meaningStory: Three pointed peaks rise from the ground to form a mountain range.

readings.story: A yak marches up the mountain: yak plus march starts you toward やま.

meaningStory: Three winding channels show water flowing down a river.

readings.story: A cow drinks from the river; cow sounds like かわ.

meaningStory: Irrigation lines divide a square plot into four rice fields.

readings.story: A rice field is a patch of terrain: terrain starts with た.

meaningStory: Five mouths exchange words; together they create a language.

readings.story: Five is 五（ご）. That same ご sound gives 語 its main N5 reading.

meaningStory: Two legs support a walking person.

readings.story: He told one person; “he told” begins like ひと.
Jim is a person; Jim points to じん.

meaningStory: A flower at the center becomes an emblem of England.

readings.story: Eight English books surround the central flower; “eight” starts with the long A sound of えい.

meaningStory: A framed sun crosses the sky once each day.

readings.story: Each day needs a daily check; “needs check” starts like にち.
Calendar days often end in か, as in 五日（いつか）.

meaningStory: Mark the root of a tree: it is the source, and also the spine of a book.

readings.story: Hon opens a book; her name gives you ほん.

meaningStory: I pull the grain toward my private side and say it is mine.

readings.story: Watashi simply introduces myself: 私（わたし）, “I.”

meaningStory: Legs taking the first step move ahead of everyone else.

readings.story: Saki takes the first step and goes ahead: Saki gives さき.
The sensei stands ahead of the class; sensei begins with せん.

meaningStory: Three tiny drops gather around a narrow center: all of them are small.

readings.story: A tiny chick says “chee”; chee sounds like ちい.

meaningStory: One evening followed by another gives you many evenings.

readings.story: “Oh, oh!” you exclaim when there are so many: おお.

meaningStory: Sweep away part of something small and only a few remain.

readings.story: Scoop only a little: scoop starts like すこ.

meaningStory: Stack a roof, windows, and walls into a tall tower.

readings.story: Taka climbs the tall tower: Taka gives たか.

meaningStory: Under a roof, a woman relaxes in a safe home with inexpensive rent.

readings.story: Yasu relaxes because the price is low: Yasu gives やす.

meaningStory: Stand by a tree with an axe and cut fresh wood for something new.

readings.story: At a raw new plank: “at a raw” recalls あたら.
A shiny new object begins with shin, like しん.

meaningStory: A mouth tells a story passed down through ten generations: it is old.

readings.story: A room full of old things: full points to ふる.

meaningStory: A woman and child happily share something they both like.

readings.story: Sue likes it: Sue begins with す.

meaningStory: When your heart loses track of everything, you are too busy.

readings.story: “I so gotta hurry!” is what a busy person says: いそが.

meaningStory: A large building gives everyone a private space because it is so wide.

readings.story: A hero needs a wide stage: hero sounds like ひろ.

meaningStory: Follow the road until the axe is close enough to reach: now it is near.

readings.story: Chika comes close: Chika gives ちか.

meaningStory: An elder's hair trails far behind, making a long shape.

readings.story: Naga wears a long scarf: Naga gives なが.

meaningStory: A sign under a street canopy marks a store or shop.

readings.story: “Me, see that shop?” gives the sounds みせ.
Ten stores line the street: ten sounds like てん.

meaningStory: The sun rises through a tree's branches in the east.

readings.story: He got up to see the eastern sun: “he got” starts you toward ひがし.

meaningStory: A bird settles into its nest where the sun sets: in the west.

readings.story: Nishi watches the sunset in the west: Nishi gives にし.

meaningStory: At a crossroads inside the border, a signpost points south.

readings.story: Mina studies the map and points south: Mina leads into みなみ.

meaningStory: Two people turn their backs against the cold wind from the north.

readings.story: The cold wind came from the north; “came” is きた too.

meaningStory: A street beside the fields grows into a town.

readings.story: Match each street on the town map: match starts like まち.

meaningStory: A person picks young leaves from a tree to make tea.

readings.story: Cha is the familiar sound of tea across many languages: ちゃ.

meaningStory: Liquid poured from a wine jar is sake or alcohol.

readings.story: The Japanese drink sake already carries its reading: さけ.

meaningStory: A head, scaly body, and sweeping tail form a fish.

readings.story: Sakana casts a net for fish: her name gives さかな.

meaningStory: Two slices laid inside a cutting board represent meat.

readings.story: Nick cooks the meat: Nick sounds like にく.

meaningStory: A plant changes and opens into a flower.

readings.story: Hannah carries a flower: Hannah gives はな.
A flower in a vase uses か, as in 花瓶（かびん）.

meaningStory: Arrive beneath a roof and you have reached a building or shop.

readings.story: A yard outside the shop starts with the sound や.

meaningStory: Horses stop at measured intervals along the route, each one a station.

readings.story: Each station marks a stop; each sounds like えき.

meaningStory: A lightning bolt drops from a storm cloud over the fields: electricity.

readings.story: Den sees electric lightning: Den gives でん.

meaningStory: Viewed from above, an axle joins the wheels of a cart or vehicle.

readings.story: The crew marks its car: crew plus mark starts you toward くるま.
A shiny vehicle begins with sha, like しゃ.

meaningStory: Take one step after another along the street to go somewhere.

readings.story: Eager feet go immediately: eager begins with the sound い.
Go on a course: course begins like こう.

meaningStory: People approach from both sides and come together beneath a tree.

readings.story: The crew comes over: crew begins with く.
A rider is coming next week: ride starts like らい.

meaningStory: Pick up the broom when you return home and sweep the floor.

readings.story: Kaede returns home; the start of Kaede gives かえ.

meaningStory: When shells 貝 served as money, a net 网 gathered that wealth together. Gather the shell money, then exchange it to buy something.

readings.story: At the CArd reader, pay to buy: CArd recalls か in 買う（かう）.

meaningStory: An eye stands on legs so it can move around and see everything.

readings.story: “Me? I see it!” Me sounds like み.

meaningStory: Lift the lid from a tray of good food and eat.

readings.story: A table is where you eat: table begins with た.
A chef shocks you with a great meal: shock sounds like しょく.

meaningStory: Read the words on every book offered for sale.

readings.story: Yo reads every word aloud: Yo gives よ.

meaningStory: An open mouth beside food is ready to drink.

readings.story: No more dry mouth: drink! No sounds like の.

meaningStory: Words leave the tongue when you talk and tell a story.

readings.story: Hannah uses her tongue to talk: Hannah gives はな, as in 話す（はなす）.
One telephone ring says “wah!”: wah points to わ.

meaningStory: A brush moves across a page to write words.

readings.story: Carve each mark as you write: carve begins with か.
Show what you wrote: show sounds like しょ.

meaningStory: The earliest form emphasized a person’s great ear listening intently. In today’s shape, remember that ear 耳 slipping inside the gate 門 to hear what is happening beyond it.

readings.story: Put your ear to the KEYhole and listen: KEY recalls き in 聞く（きく）.
The gate 門 was historically the sound clue in 聞, pointing toward ぶん—the reading preserved in 新聞（しんぶん）.

meaningStory: At evening, follow the direction sign that points outside.

readings.story: So Tom waits outside: “so Tom” begins like そと.
A guide leads you outside: guide begins like がい.

meaningStory: The sky stretches above even the largest person: the heavens.

readings.story: Ten stars fill the heavens: ten sounds like てん.

meaningStory: Drops fall from a cloud-filled window: rain.

readings.story: A meadow needs rain: “a meadow” begins like あめ.

meaningStory: Do not escape the effort: exert your strength and study hard.

readings.story: Ben bends over his books to study: Ben gives べん.

meaningStory: A tiny insect pulls a heavy bow, proving it is amazingly strong.

readings.story: Two yo-yos pull against each other strongly: “two yo” recalls つよ.
Kyō trains every day to grow strong: Kyō gives きょう.

meaningStory: Gold nuggets and royal treasure are stored safely under a roof.

readings.story: Can a gold coin buy it? “Can a” sounds like かね.
A king guards the gold: king begins like きん.

meaningStory: A plant rises from a line of ground and reveals the soil beneath it.

readings.story: Dough dropped on the soil begins with ど.

meaningStory: A clock hand sits under a cover and points to this exact moment: now.

readings.story: Emma wants it now: Emma sounds like いま.
Concentrate on the current moment: concentrate begins with こん.

meaningStory: The crescent moon completes a cycle that once marked each month.

readings.story: Two keys shine in the moonlight: “two keys” sounds like つき.
Get the calendar for this month: get starts like げつ.
Gather all twelve months: gather starts like がつ.

meaningStory: In the ancient form, a person carries the grain harvest. From one harvest to the next, the seasons complete a cycle: one year has passed.

readings.story: Toshi celebrates another year: Toshi gives とし.
Name each new year; name begins like ねん.

meaningStory: Two sparks rise from a pair of dancing flames: fire.

readings.story: A car catches fire: car begins with か.

meaningStory: A central stream splashes droplets to both sides: water.

readings.story: Me at the zoo needs water: “me zoo” sounds like みず.
Sweet water starts with sui, like すい.

meaningStory: A trunk, roots, and spreading branches form a tree and its wood.

readings.story: A key hangs from the tree: key sounds like き.
Moss covers the wood: moss begins like もく.

meaningStory: When the sun and moon shine together, everything becomes bright.

readings.story: At dawn, the sun is red — 赤い（あかい）— as its light makes the sky bright — 明るい（あかるい）. Red and brightness share あか.
MEIJI（明治） was named for rule toward a bright, enlightened direction: MEI gives めい, the light in 明.

meaningStory: A person checks every square on the calendar, without missing one.

readings.story: My calendar has something every day: my sounds like まい.

meaningStory: At the crossroads, the sun replaces the moon and morning begins.

readings.story: A sunny morning begins with “a su-,” like あさ.

meaningStory: A measuring stick tracks the sun above the horizon until noon and daytime.

readings.story: He will eat at noon: “he'll” sounds like ひる.

meaningStory: A person takes shelter under a roof as evening deepens into night.

readings.story: Your night is quiet: your sounds like よる.

meaningStory: The sun escapes below the horizon and the evening begins.

readings.story: A band starts playing in the evening: band begins like ばん.

meaningStory: A crescent appears when daylight fades into evening.

readings.story: You watch the evening sky: you sounds like ゆう.

meaningStory: A temple bell follows the sun and announces the time.

readings.story: A talking clock tells the time: talky points to とき.
Gee, look at the time! Gee sounds like じ.

meaningStory: Split ten into two equal groups and each group is half.

readings.story: A hand breaks the loaf in half: hand begins like はん.

meaningStory: A person plants a sign at noon: before this marker is 午前, and after it is 午後.

readings.story: Go to lunch at noon: go sounds like ご.

meaningStory: Following footsteps trail behind on a thread, always coming after.

readings.story: Add to what comes after: “add to” sounds like あと.
You see a row behind you: “you see row” recalls うしろ.

meaningStory: Travel one complete lap around the road and another week has passed.

readings.story: Your shoe walks the weekly circuit: shoe sounds like しゅう.

meaningStory: A bright feathered bird assigns a different color to every weekday.

readings.story: Yo, which weekday is it? Yo sounds like よう.

meaningStory: A knife divides something into separate parts.

readings.story: Divide a bun into parts: bun sounds like ぶん.
Minutes are fine divisions of an hour: fine begins like ふん.

meaningStory: Turn away from the ground you knew and leave it behind: gone.

readings.story: Kyoto was last year's trip: Kyoto begins with きょ.

meaningStory: A pig kept safely under a roof shows a settled and prosperous home.

readings.story: “Yeah, this is my house!” Yeah sounds like いえ.
A family gathers at home; family starts with the sound か.

meaningStory: A clan gathers behind one flag and follows the same arrow.

readings.story: A whole family visits the zoo: zoo starts like ぞく.

meaningStory: A father holds two crossed tools in steady hands to fix the house.

readings.story: Children cheer twice for their father: cheer-cheer points to ちち.

meaningStory: The two marks inside show a mother nourishing and holding her child.

readings.story: A mother laughs “ha-ha”: はは.

meaningStory: A baby with outstretched arms and wrapped legs forms the shape of a child.

readings.story: A child coos; coo begins with こ.

meaningStory: A man uses his strength to work the field.

readings.story: Oh, Tom works with the man in the field: “oh Tom” leads into おとこ.

meaningStory: The flowing shape pictures a woman kneeling with folded arms.

readings.story: Anna is the woman in the picture: Anna sounds like おんな.

meaningStory: Sunlight visible through a gate marks the interval between its doors.

readings.story: A can fits in the gap between the doors: can sounds like かん.

meaningStory: A cart carries matching loads on both sides of its balance beam.

readings.story: Rio holds both handles: Rio sounds like りょう.

meaningStory: A parent stands beside a tree and watches over the children.

readings.story: Shin's parents watch over him: Shin gives しん.

meaningStory: The right hand brings food to the mouth.

readings.story: Mickey raises his right hand: Mickey starts like みぎ.

meaningStory: The left hand steadies a tool while the right hand works.

readings.story: He dares to write with his left hand: “he dares” recalls ひだり.

meaningStory: A mark sits above the reference line: up, over, and on top.

readings.story: Way up above: way sounds like うえ.
Joe stands on top: Joe sounds like じょう.

meaningStory: A mark hangs below the reference line: under and beneath.

readings.story: She sat down below: “she sat” recalls した.
The corridor goes down to the floor below; down can use か.

meaningStory: A line pierces the exact middle of a box: inside and center.

readings.story: Naka stands in the middle: Naka gives なか.
Choose the center: choose sounds like ちゅう.

meaningStory: The older brother stands tall on long legs and speaks for the younger children.

readings.story: Annie asks her older brother: Annie begins like あに.
Kyō gathers all the siblings: Kyō gives きょう.

meaningStory: The older sister leads the way through the busy market.

readings.story: Ann is the older sister: Ann sounds like あね.

meaningStory: The younger brother proudly carries his little practice bow.

readings.story: “Oh, Toto!” calls the younger brother: “oh Toto” recalls おとうと.
The siblings share the sound dai, as in 兄弟（きょうだい）.

meaningStory: The younger sister is the woman who has not yet caught up in age.

readings.story: Emo Toto is the younger sister's nickname: it recalls いもうと.

meaningStory: Fingers branch from a palm and wrist to form a hand.

readings.story: Ten fingers belong to your hands: ten starts with て.

meaningStory: A leg runs from its kneecap down to a planted foot.

readings.story: Ash sticks to a bare foot: ash sounds like あし.

meaningStory: Sharing grain so every mouth is fed creates harmony.

readings.story: “Wow, what harmony!” Wow begins with わ.

meaningStory: A sheep crosses a vast stretch of water toward the ocean and the West.

readings.story: Yo, that sheep crossed the ocean! Yo sounds like よう.

meaningStory: A hand pulls fabric snugly over the body: clothes.

readings.story: A full suitcase is packed with clothes: full begins like ふく.

meaningStory: Cool blue settles a conflict until everything becomes quiet and calm.

readings.story: Shizu whispers for everyone to be quiet: Shizu gives しず.

meaningStory: A person leans against a tree to rest in its shade.

readings.story: Yasu rests against the tree: やす, as in 休む（やすむ）.

meaningStory: A person confined inside a sickbed is ill.

readings.story: Be your own nurse when ill: “be your” starts like びょう.

meaningStory: A complete building on a hill becomes a large institution such as a hospital.

readings.story: Go in the institution: in sounds like いん.

meaningStory: Vapor and a spark swirl into invisible energy, spirit, and mood.

readings.story: A key turns on the energy: key sounds like き.

meaningStory: Pain travels through the body like a passage beneath a sickbed.

readings.story: “Eek, it hurts!” starts with a sound like いた.

meaningStory: Legs stand on two starting lines, ready at the beginning.

readings.story: Begin again: again ends with a sound like げん.

meaningStory: A sharp tool stored in a medical case belongs to a doctor.

readings.story: “E! Call the doctor!” The first cry gives い.

meaningStory: An elder standing in the sun represents a person, someone known by their role.

readings.story: A shy person starts with sha, like しゃ.

meaningStory: Your footsteps stop at the temple gate, where you must wait.

readings.story: Ma waits at the gate: Ma gives ま.

meaningStory: Once you arrive under the roof, you are inside a room.

readings.story: Sheets fill the room: sheets sounds like しつ.

meaningStory: A bean bounces off the top of a head.

readings.story: A tomato hits your head: “a tomato” starts like あたま.

meaningStory: Herbs bring comfort when prepared as medicine.

readings.story: Cook Sue's remedy: “cook Sue re-” recalls くすり.

meaningStory: Words from a mouth fly straight like an arrow when you truly know the answer.

readings.story: She knows the answer: she sounds like し.

meaningStory: Two people sit on the ground inside a shelter.

readings.story: Sue watches everyone sit: “Sue wa-” recalls すわ.

meaningStory: A person's head and shoulders rise upright from the ground: stand up.

readings.story: A tall person stands up: tall begins with た.

meaningStory: Add a round belly dot to a large body and it becomes plump and thick.

readings.story: A full tummy makes you plump: “full tummy” starts like ふと.

meaningStory: A path bends and turns as it crosses a boxed field.

readings.story: A map shows where the road bends: map begins with ま.

meaningStory: A person stops in one place, stays there, and eventually makes it home.

readings.story: Sue lives here: Sue begins with す.

meaningStory: Something emerges from an open container and exits.

readings.story: Depart through the exit: depart begins with で.
Dad takes something out: Dad begins with だ.

meaningStory: Two strokes converge toward an opening as they enter.

readings.story: Hike into the entrance: hike begins like はい.
Ease the object in: ease begins with い.

meaningStory: Your eye checks a wool garment as you put it on and arrive dressed.

readings.story: The key is in the coat you wear: key sounds like き.
Two trains arrive: two begins with つ.

meaningStory: Release fabric from the body to undress and take it off.

readings.story: You become nearly nude after taking clothes off: nude begins with ぬ.

meaningStory: A person in constant movement is hard at work.

readings.story: Hata labors all day: Hata plus labor starts you toward はたら.

meaningStory: Thoughts grow in the heart like crops filling a field.

readings.story: Oh, Moe is thinking again: “oh Moe” sounds like おも.

meaningStory: A person attends to their duties like a disciplined professional: this is work.

readings.story: She attends to the job: she sounds like し.

meaningStory: A hand hooks a spoken task from the mouth: a matter that must be handled.

readings.story: In 仕事（しごと）, こと voices to ごと: every job is a matter to handle.

meaningStory: A guiding hand helps a child learn from an elder: to teach.

readings.story: “Oh, she can teach!” starts with おし.
Kyō teaches in the classroom: Kyō gives きょう.

meaningStory: People gather under one cloud of conversation for a meeting.

readings.story: “Ow!” Two people bump into each other when they meet: ow sounds like あ.
A crowd comes together for a meeting: crowd begins like かい.

meaningStory: A lid fits perfectly over its container.

readings.story: “Ah, it fits!” Ah gives the reading あ.

meaningStory: A merchant under a stall roof waits for customers so they can sell goods.

readings.story: Ooh, that item sold quickly! Ooh sounds like う.

meaningStory: Sound waves stack above a mouth as someone says words.

readings.story: “E!” is the first thing you say: E sounds like い.
Quote the words someone said: quote starts you toward こと.

meaningStory: An arrow no longer than a bean is remarkably short.

readings.story: A midge can fit on the short arrow: “midge can” recalls みじか.

meaningStory: People gather at an altar on shared land, like members of a company or society.

readings.story: Shares belong to a company: shares begins like しゃ.

meaningStory: The eyes of the people close when everyone goes to sleep.

readings.story: Never move while asleep: “never move” starts like ねむ.

meaningStory: Lift the cover to reveal a swirling palette of color.

readings.story: An easel rolls out every color: “easel roll” starts like いろ.

meaningStory: Earth glows above a hot fire until it turns red.

readings.story: A car painted red: “a car” sounds like あか.

meaningStory: A fresh plant under cool moonlight takes on a blue-green color.

readings.story: “Ow!” A blue bruise makes you cry あお.

meaningStory: One brilliant ray makes the sun appear pure white.

readings.story: She wrote on a white sheet: “she wrote” starts like しろ.

meaningStory: A fire leaves the whole village covered in black soot.

readings.story: A crow is black: crow sounds like くろ.

meaningStory: Everyone climbs a hill one level at a time, like the storeys of a building.

readings.story: Climb sky-high, one floor at a time: high ends like かい.

meaningStory: One circuit turns around another, marking a complete round or occurrence.

readings.story: Count each circuit: count starts with the sound かい.

meaningStory: Two hands lift the bars inside a gate and open it.

readings.story: “Ah!” Fresh air enters when the gate opens: ah gives あ.

meaningStory: Drop a wooden bar across the gate and it is closed.

readings.story: She shuts the gate: she sounds like し.

meaningStory: The sun is already up before the clock reaches ten: early.

readings.story: Hurry if you want to be early: hurry sounds like はや.

meaningStory: The older form 步 shows one foot following another. In modern 歩, the lower foot is distorted, but the pair still walks step by step.

readings.story: The two feet walk along a route: “a route” starts like ある.
In 散歩（さんぽ）, ほ voices to ぽ: imagine footsteps popping along on a walk.

meaningStory: A foot races so quickly that it barely touches the ground: run.

readings.story: Hashi runs across the bridge: Hashi gives はし.

meaningStory: A metal with a lasting pale shine is silver.

readings.story: Gin gleams in a silver flask: gin sounds like ぎん.

meaningStory: A building divided around a service counter becomes a bureau or post office.

readings.story: Kyoko works at the bureau: Kyoko begins like きょく.

meaningStory: A person takes an official tool and puts it to use.

readings.story: Two carpenters use the tool: “two ca-” recalls つか.

meaningStory: A scoop measures rice to calculate the amount, ingredients, or fee.

readings.story: Rio measures the fee with a scoop: Rio sounds like りょう.

meaningStory: A hand gives up a private coin to pay.

readings.story: Hand over hard cash to pay: hand plus cash starts you toward はら.

meaningStory: A hand holds a precious object steady all the way to the temple.

readings.story: Moe holds the bag: Moe sounds like も.

meaningStory: The ancient form depicts a person with a pattern tattooed on their chest. That pattern became a written sign, then writing and a sentence.

readings.story: At the BUN SHOW, every bun bears a written sentence: BUN SHOW gives ぶんしょう.

meaningStory: A child under a school roof learns each written character.

readings.story: Gee, that character is complex! Gee sounds like じ.

meaningStory: Put a tag on a cow and it becomes one concrete thing in the inventory.

readings.story: Mono means one; point to one thing and remember もの.
Boots are concrete objects: boots sounds like ぶつ.

meaningStory: Three stacked boxes are full of goods and products.

readings.story: She names every item of goods: “she names” starts like しな.

meaningStory: A bird speaks human words, so everyone asks: who said that?

readings.story: Dare to ask who: dare sounds like だれ.

meaningStory: A person takes sudden action and makes something new.

readings.story: Two cooks make the meal: “two cooks” sounds like つく.
Sack the materials together to make a work: sack sounds like さく.

meaningStory: A stroke of resolve pierces the heart: something that must invariably be done.

readings.story: He'd sue if this necessary task is skipped: “he'd sue” recalls ひつ.

meaningStory: A person trapped beneath a net needs help.

readings.story: “E! I need help!” The first cry gives い.

meaningStory: A traveler follows a flag with packed clothes for a trip.

readings.story: Rio packs for a trip: Rio sounds like りょ.

meaningStory: Bills pile on top of shell money: every trip has an expense.

readings.story: He pays the expense: he sounds like ひ.

meaningStory: Carry a parcel along the road to send or escort it.

readings.story: Send the parcel past the oak: oak sounds like おく.

meaningStory: Two axes inspect shell money closely to judge its quality and substance.

readings.story: Sheets are checked for fabric quality: sheets sounds like しつ.

meaningStory: A mouth at the gate calls out a question before entering.

readings.story: A monster at the gate asks a question: monster begins with もん.

meaningStory: Landmarks and crossed routes drawn inside a border make a map or diagram.

readings.story: Zoom into the map: zoom begins with ず.

meaningStory: An official building large enough to serve food becomes a public hall or venue.

readings.story: A canteen belongs in a large building: canteen begins with かん.

meaningStory: A cloth mat under a shelter marks your seat.

readings.story: Secure your seat: secure begins with せき.

meaningStory: Circle a subject with words to investigate, check, and fine-tune every detail.

readings.story: She writes a report after checking: “she writes” starts like しら.

meaningStory: Exchange clear words until an opinion becomes an explanation.

readings.story: Set out the explanation step by step: set sounds like せつ.

meaningStory: See the learning sparks under the roof and fix them in memory.

readings.story: “Oh boy, remember this!” Oh boy starts like おぼ.

meaningStory: When something is lost from the heart, you forget it.

readings.story: Was it forgotten? “Was” points to わす.

meaningStory: Arrange bamboo slips until the right pieces fit: that is the answer.

readings.story: The coat answers the weather problem: coat starts like こた.

meaningStory: A roof that can shelter a hundred people is an inn or lodging.

readings.story: A shoe queue forms outside the inn: “shoe queue” recalls しゅく.

meaningStory: Keep the correct statement at the head of the page as its topic or title.

readings.story: A diagram presents the topic: diagram begins with だい.

meaningStory: A person reaches toward a missing piece and feels its lack.

readings.story: In 欠席（けっせき）, けつ contracts to けっ: the missing seat cuts the sound short.

meaningStory: Strings stretched over wood make music that brings comfort and fun.

readings.story: Gaku plays music: Gaku gives がく.
Ta-da! The music is fun: ta-da points to たの.

meaningStory: When everything feels wrong above the heart, it becomes sad and grieves.

readings.story: Can a heart bear this sadness? “Can a” sounds like かな.

meaningStory: A sound reaches the heart and becomes an idea, intention, or meaning.

readings.story: “E!” is the sound of a sudden idea: E sounds like い.

meaningStory: Two feet spring from a launch platform at the moment of departure.

readings.story: In 発表（はっぴょう）, はつ contracts to はっ: the announcement bursts out and cuts the sound short.

meaningStory: A sign displayed on the outside of clothes presents information on the surface.

readings.story: In 発表（はっぴょう）, ひょう voices to ぴょう: the displayed announcement makes the sound pop.

meaningStory: The mouth tests food that is not yet ripe and discovers its flavor.

readings.story: Me? I taste the flavor: me sounds like み.

meaningStory: Pointing at your own nose means oneself or self.

readings.story: Gee, that is me myself! Gee sounds like じ.

meaningStory: Under a roof, choose the correct path and determine a fixed plan.

readings.story: They determine the plan: they sounds like てい.

meaningStory: Shell money saved for what comes next becomes a useful asset or resource.

readings.story: She owns the assets: she sounds like し.

meaningStory: At school, people exchange ideas beside a tree before an exam.

readings.story: A cohort studies at school: cohort begins with こう.
